module.purpose: Implements RTK Query's automatic polling middleware. Exports buildPollingHandler, a factory closed over shared poll/subscription state that returns a synchronous redux middleware handler. The handler inspects incoming actions (subscription option changes, unsubscribes, pending/rejected/fulfilled thunk transitions, and api-state resets) and routes them to batched scheduling logic: subscription-option updates are coalesced into a single setTimeout(0) batch, each active query key maintains its own setTimeout that recursively reschedules refetches, the minimum polling interval is reduced across all subscribers, focused-window gating suppresses refetches when unfocused, and cleanup clears stale timeouts before replacement and purges everything on state reset. Lives at packages/toolkit/src/query/core/buildMiddleware/polling.ts as one of the core middleware builders consumed by the RTK Query api middleware pipeline.
module.summary: This module implements the polling subsystem for RTK Query's middleware layer. It exports a single factory that closes over shared polling state (a Map of active polls and a Map of subscriptions) and returns a synchronous redux middleware handler. The handler inspects incoming actions — subscription option changes, unsubscribe events, pending/rejected/fulfilled thunk transitions, and api-state resets — and routes them to the appropriate scheduling routine. Polling updates are batched into a single setTimeout(0) callback to coalesce frequent option changes, while each active query key maintains its own setTimeout that recursively reschedules refetches. The minimum polling interval is derived by reducing across all subscribers of a query, and focused-window gating prevents refetches when the tab is unfocused. Cleanup is centralized so that stale timeouts are cleared before replacement and the entire poll set can be purged on state reset.
module.businessContext: RTK Query automatic background refetching of queries on configurable intervals. Drives data freshness for dashboards and live views; if polling breaks, cached query data goes stale and UIs display outdated content.

concurrencyModel.notes: The handler runs synchronously per dispatched action, but scheduling is asynchronous via setTimeout(0) batching and per-key setTimeout recursion. Multiple per-key timers may overlap, but per-key timeout clearing serializes each key's own timer. pendingPollingUpdates accumulates and flushes on the next tick.
